name: Gitea
description: Self-hosted Git service with a web UI, issues and pull requests.

env.label: Database
env.description: sqlite3 needs nothing else. Set postgres to use an external database, then fill in the host values below.

env.label: Root URL
env.description: The address people reach this instance on. Set it to the real one before the first sign-in or the links Gitea hands out will be wrong.

env.label: Advertised SSH port
env.description: The SSH port Gitea tells users to clone over. It has to match the host port published above.

volumes.label: Repositories, configuration and the SQLite database

notes: The first account that registers becomes the administrator.
